decision: Preserve quiet speech; reduce false text without losing any speech in this evaluation.
evaluation_design: 177 exploratory cases followed by 474 different recordings/noise cases. Candidate thresholds were predefined, but final policy selection used these results. The latter set is not an untouched final test. FSDD speakers overlap between sets.
limits: Speech accepted by VAD does not imply accurate ASR. Pre-existing short-audio errors and recognition mistakes remain.
Synthetic noise and mostly English speech; no personal microphone recordings or unseen-speaker generalization test.
Tone/hum inputs still produce false transcripts.

detector_latency_ms.note: Warm detector measured separately from ASR; not end-to-end dictation latency.
